doc: Rebirth/Documentation/research/RE-chocobo-exits-pads.md (sections 2 and 3; both databases read by the CHOCOEXITS pass; slots and bytes in research/.ida-mcp/chocobo-exits/1005_sites_and_bytes.asm.txt; the entry bytes read from both exes)

facts.name: vt_AEndFieldActionChocoboJumpBoxActor
facts.note: Found by the callers of FieldActionActor_RegisterWithCharacterPC618 and the register's data xref (vtable +0x738); the slots sit +8 from 1.004.

facts.name: vt_AEndFieldActionChocoboSliderActor
facts.note: The same way; the slider's register (0x143397064) computes the direction byte +0x768 from the leader in both builds.

facts.name: ChocoboJumpStandActor_OnTriggerEnd_Unregister (1.004 vt+0x738, 1.005 vt+0x740)
facts.note: Unregisters the stored weak +0x734 from the character's controller list and clears it; size 0x70 both builds.

facts.name: ChocoboJumpBoxActor_OnTriggerEnd_Unregister (1.004 vt+0x738, 1.005 vt+0x740)
facts.note: Unregisters the stored weak +0x7A0, clears it and the combo frame +0x7A8; size 0x7b both builds.

facts.name: ChocoboSliderActor_OnTriggerEnd_Unregister (1.004 vt+0x738, 1.005 vt+0x740)
facts.note: Unregisters the stored weak +0x760 and clears it; size 0x70 both builds.

facts.name: slot: launch pad try-begin (1.004 vt+0x740, 1.005 vt+0x748)
facts.note: Holds ChocoboJumpStandActor_TryLaunchGlide (1.004 0x1436663C0, 1.005 0x14339BAD0: replaced-chocobo-traversal.json) in both exes.

facts.name: slot: jump box try-begin (1.004 vt+0x740, 1.005 vt+0x748)
ChocoboJumpBoxActor_TryBegin
facts.note: (actor, dt xmm1, pawn r8): enabled, a chocobo, CanStartFieldAction_Ex, PrimaryPCMode_Vt2A8ForActor == 2, then the combo window or grounded + idle + distance + facing; requests state 8. Size 0x3d5 both builds.

facts.name: ChocoboSliderActor_TryBegin
facts.note: (actor, dt xmm1, pawn r8): the same gates, grounded, idle, speed and the spline's heading; requests state 8. Size 0x493 both builds.

facts.name: slot: jump box per-frame update (1.004 vt+0x748, 1.005 vt+0x750)
ChocoboJumpBoxActor_Update_ComboJumpFrame
facts.note: (actor, context; the pawn at context+8): when the pawn is the stored leader or its ride body (through the primary controller's coordinator) and its executer belongs to another jump box, the combo frame +0x7A8 = GFrameCounter. Size 0xaf both builds.

facts.name: slot: UEndChocoboJetGaugeComponent BeginPlay (1.004 vt+0x350, 1.005 vt+0x358)
facts.note: Holds ChocoboJetGaugeComp_BeginPlay_CreatesWidget (below) in both exes; the component vtable is 0x1467ED380 / 0x1466792F8.

facts.name: ChocoboJetGaugeComp_BeginPlay_CreatesWidget
facts.note: (component): creates the gauge widget on the root overlay (ChocoboJetGauge_CreateWidget_RootOverlay, replaced-chocobo-traversal.json). Size 0x38 both builds.

facts.name: ChocoboJetGaugeComp_PlaceWidget_FirstLocalPlayerView
facts.note: (component): when the widget exists and the gauge shows, the owner's socket position projected through UWorld's first local player, SetPositionInViewport, the show/hide animations and the fill. Called by the component's tick each frame; stateless beyond the cached position. Same shape in both builds (the 1.005 exe's bytes: 40 53 B8 50 00 00 00 E8 BC E2 62 FE 48 2B E0 48 83 B9 C0 00 00 00 00 48).
